source: ggui iframe-runtime + mcp-server handler wire schemas, hand-assembled from the shapes the shipping code emits
note: Authored-from-real-shapes, NOT a live capture (FIXTURES.md Layer B, workspace#10). Every frame shape is copied out of ggui's shipping source, not invented — the per-frame map is `sourceMap` below. Stable/incidental discipline for this transcript: see ENROLLMENT.md in this directory (the enrollment draft of record for silverprotocol/workspace).

sourceMap.emits: the MCP-Apps bootstrap: wire shape (incl. the nextStep → ggui_consume hint) per the render handler's zod output schema, wrapped in the server's {structuredContent, content:[stringified], _meta} success envelope; the _meta['ai.ggui/render'] slice and _meta.ui.resourceUri are the deriveRenderMeta projection (the single projection function every ggui transport shares)
the client-originated gesture: kind:'dispatch' envelope carrying intent + actionData + uiContext snapshot + actionId + firedAt, exactly as the iframe runtime dispatches it over the channel transport
the accept-with-no-consumer report: {ok, consumerPresent:false} per the submit handler's zod output schema, in the same success envelope — consumerPresent:false is the doorbell's precondition

the pure doorbell the iframe posts to the host: directive text (agent instruction, prose incidental) AND the content-block _meta['ai.ggui/userAction'] structured mirror (typed GguiUserActionMeta, kind:'user-action', actionId echo, nextStep → ggui_consume) — a verbatim copy of the production postToParent frame

the drain call a fresh agent turn issues by obeying the doorbell directive: arguments per the consume handler's zod input schema (sessionId + timeout), matching the next_tool/next_args the doorbell text carries

the drained gesture: {events:[ConsumeEventEntry {type:'action', sessionId, intent, actionData, uiContext, actionId, firedAt}], status} per the consume handler's zod output schema, in the same success envelope
